from google.cloud import pubsub_v1

def publish_event(project_id, topic_id, data):
    publisher = pubsub_v1.PublisherClient()
    topic_path = publisher.topic_path(project_id, topic_id)
    data = json.dumps(data).encode('utf-8')
    publisher.publish(topic_path, data=data)

from google.cloud import pubsub_v1

def consume_event(project_id, subscription_id):
    subscriber = pubsub_v1.SubscriberClient()
    subscription_path = subscriber.subscription_path(project_id, subscription_id)
    response = subscriber.pull(subscription_path, max_messages=1)
    return response.received_messages[0].message if response.received_messages else None

from google.cloud import pubsub_v1

def dead_letter(project_id, topic_id, data):
    publisher = pubsub_v1.PublisherClient()
    topic_path = publisher.topic_path(project_id, topic_id)
    data = json.dumps(data).encode('utf-8')
    publisher.publish(topic_path, data=data)

from google.cloud import pubsub_v1

def batch_publish(project_id, topic_id, messages):
    publisher = pubsub_v1.PublisherClient()
    topic_path = publisher.topic_path(project_id, topic_id)
    future_results = [publisher.publish(topic_path, json.dumps(message).encode('utf-8')) for message in messages]
    return [future.result() for future in future_results]

from google.cloud import logging

def summarize_message_processing(project_id, log_name, resource, message):
    client = logging.Client()
    logger = client.logger(log_name)
    logger.log_struct(message, resource=resource)

from google.cloud import securitycenter

def check_message_safety(project_id, source, finding):
    client = securitycenter.SecurityCenterClient()
    parent = client.organization_path(project_id, source)
    finding = client.create_finding(parent, finding)

from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate

def translate_payload(project_id, text, target_language):
    client = translate.Client()
    result = client.translate(text, target_language=target_language)
    return result['translatedText']

from google.cloud import storage

def store_message_audit(project_id, bucket_name, message):
    client = storage.Client()
    bucket = client.bucket(bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.blob('message_audit.json')
    blob.upload_from_string(json.dumps(message))
